FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited for the following position at DST - Centre for Policy
Research (CPR) at Panjab University, Chandigarh
Name of post: Project Associate I
No. of Vacancies: 01
Nature of post: Temporary and co-terminus with project
Work Place: PCPM Division, Department of Science and Technology, New Delhi
Essential Qualification:
1. Master’s degree in Science or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a
recognized university with 55% marks or equivalent grades.
2. Age: Less than 35 years
Salary:
1. Rs. 31,000/- + HRA as applicable to the candidates who have qualified NET conducted by
UGC-CSIR/DBT or GATE.
2. Rs 25000/- + HRA for candidates without NET or GATE.
Conditions:
1. Candidates are advised to send the complete application along with essential
documents/proofs in support of claims as hard copy to the “Coordinator, DST Centre for
policy research, Room no 410, top floor, Guru Tegh Bahadur Bhawan, Sector 14 Panjab
University, Chandigarh-160014”.
2. The CV and the additional information asked is to be sent only in the prescribed proforma
enclosed as attachment-1. Do not send your CV via e-mail. It will not be entertained.
3. The application will be rejected if it is not sent in the prescribed proforma, or is
incomplete.
4. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail for the Interview.
5. The last date for the submission of application is 26.03.2024 (Tuesday) till 5 pm.
6. For Query, please contact at Tel No:- 0172-2534124 between 2:00 pm to 3:00 pm.
